Fix `plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. CI=1 yarn test plugins/catalog fails.
1) <CatalogEntityPage /> > redirects an old URL to the renamed entity and shows the notice (CatalogEntityPage.test.tsx:99) and Entity page > Renamed entities > redirects a former URL and shows the renamed notice (alpha/pages.test.tsx:1337): expect(alerts[0].message).toContain('component:default/old-name'); Received: "This entity was renamed from component:default/new-name. Please update your links and bookmarks."
Cause: formerLookup.value stays set after the redirect; when the route params change to the new name, the redirect effect runs again and overwrites renamedFrom with the NEW ref (stringifyEntityRef({kind, namespace, name}) of the current params). The redirect must fire once per not-found ref: only navigate when formerLookup resolved for the params it was looked up for (e.g. return {fromRef, toRef} from the lookup and navigate only while the current params equal fromRef, and never when the entity loaded), so renamedFrom keeps the old ref.
2) Entity page > Renamed entities > keeps the not-found page when nothing claims the ref (alpha/pages.test.tsx:1367): screen.findByText('Entity not found') not found, and alertApi must have 0 alerts. When getEntityByRef returns undefined and getEntityRefByFormerRef resolves undefined (or throws), the hook must return the same not-found status as before the change (entity undefined, loading false, no error, no navigation, no alert). Check loading is not held true while the former lookup is pending or after it resolved empty, and that no navigate('/') happens on that path.
